purpose: Materialize the already-declared harmful-minus-harmless secondary cost interaction and separately report physical consequence counts, completion and elapsed time. No primary endpoint, request, gate, source or fit changes.

formulas.cost_interaction: Per world, [(ablation_high-ablation_zero)-(baseline_high-baseline_zero)] harmful minus harmless; policy strata separate.
formulas.per_cost: Per world, (ablation-baseline) harmful minus harmless at fixed cost.
formulas.consequences: Mean over three menus within each world, then equal world means within each family; families have different units and stay separate.
